figurative_meaning_en: Administering a sound thrashing; beating someone flat
similar_in_english: Beat the living daylights out of someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: বেশি বাড়াবাড়ি করলে তোমার আড়ং ধোলাই হবে।
সে তার ভাইকে আড়ং ধোলাই দিয়ে শিক্ষা দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: If you act too cheeky, you'll get a sound thrashing.
He gave his brother a thorough beating to teach him a lesson.
note: This idiom is often used in informal, rural Bengali speech to warn against overstepping boundaries.
